# SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp

**diamond 的 SDP 表示**

给出有限维 diamond 范数的 primal 与 dual SDP 表达，在正确的严格可行条件下证明强对偶与最优值达成，并把 channel discrimination 成功概率界接入统一范数。

**边界**：qDRIFT 误差归 Concepts-FINITE-DIAMOND-QDRIFT/Concepts-SIM-QDRIFT，本 block 不重复；非 Hermitian/矩形情形须保留准确公式。

**覆盖等级**：D

| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.measurementSuccess` | def | L62 | The equal-prior binary success functional, defined as half the sum of the real traces of `M * rho` and `(1 - M) * sigma`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.tensorLeft_trace_sub_eq_zero` | theorem | L67 | The amplified difference of two trace-preserving maps has trace zero on every input matrix. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.measurementSuccess_eq_half_add_centered` | theorem | L77 | If `sigma` has trace one and `rho - sigma` has trace zero, binary measurement success equals `1/2` plus half the real trace pairing of `M - (1/2) I` with `rho - sigma`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.opNorm_centered_effect_le` | theorem | L132 | If both `M` and `1 - M` are positive semidefinite, the centered effect `M - (1/2) I` has L2 operator norm at most `1/2`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.abs_trace_centered_effect_le` | theorem | L193 | For a binary effect `M` and any matrix `Delta`, the absolute real trace pairing of `M - (1/2) I` with `Delta` is at most `traceNorm Delta / 2`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.measurementSuccess_le_half_add_quarter` | theorem | L208 | If `M` and `1 - M` are positive semidefinite, `sigma` has trace one, and `rho - sigma` has trace zero, then `measurementSuccess M rho sigma <= 1/2 + traceNorm (rho - sigma) / 4`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.measurementSuccess_le_half_add_diamond` | theorem | L220 | For two trace-preserving maps with difference of finite diamond norm at most nonnegative `delta`, every density input with a finite reference and every binary effect have measurement success at most `1/2 + delta / 4`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.binaryEffectPOVM` | def | L251 | The Boolean POVM with effect `M` for outcome `true` and effect `1 - M` for outcome `false`, assuming both effects are positive semidefinite. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.discriminationLaw` | def | L264 | The normalized finite law of an equally likely Boolean label and the outcome of `I`, using state `rho` for label `true` and `sigma` for label `false`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.discriminationLaw_label` | theorem | L278 | Each hidden label in `discriminationLaw` has marginal probability `1/2`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.discriminationLaw_success` | theorem | L287 | For the instrument associated with `binaryEffectPOVM M`, the probability that outcome equals label in `discriminationLaw` is exactly `measurementSuccess M rho sigma`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.discriminationLaw_success_le_diamond` | theorem | L301 | If the difference of two quantum channels has finite diamond norm at most nonnegative `delta`, their equal-prior discrimination law on any density input and binary effect has correct-label probability at most `1/2 + delta / 4`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.referenceDiscriminationLaw` | def | L364 | The equal-prior discrimination law for channel outputs on a joint system-reference density input, measured with binary effect `M`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.SchattenDiamond.DiamondSdp.referenceDiscriminationLaw_success_le` | theorem | L384 | If the channel difference has finite diamond norm at most nonnegative `delta`, the correct-label probability in `referenceDiscriminationLaw` is at most `1/2 + delta / 4` for every finite reference, density input, and binary effect. |
